rationale: P identifies vehicle braking itself as the behaviour to characterise, as required by SG-3 and the H-3 hazardous event of suddenly stopping without an obstacle ahead. Its declared scope matches the supplied operational situation. Braking behaviour is therefore part of the evaluation subject, not merely a control mechanism affecting it. P does not incorporate sensing, computation, communication, failure-mitigation mechanisms, or their timing constraints.
determining_elements: “Vehicle braking behavior” directly addresses the target of preventing unintended braking.
“Whether braking occurs without a forward obstacle present” captures the relationship specified by the H-3 hazardous event.
The scope—straight-ahead driving on a less frequented urban road at 50 km/h, in good weather, without visible obstacles or vehicles ahead—is supported by H-3.
